goal: Every delivered research report, whatever its purpose template, carries the discipline of the OptiPlex buyer's guide the operator approved on 2026-09-12: a title stating the finding, an executive summary, a purpose-specific action or findings section, a findings-by-area table with a citation per row, what the evidence does not settle, ONE limitations section, sources; the buyer's guide stays a distinct template among the others (about ten today), none is deleted; and the fidelity check's footer never claims more coverage than it has.
artifact: Patch to OB1/integrations/research-service/templates.ts: every existing template (scientific-paper, technical-proposal, nontechnical-proposal, programming-doc, engineering-doc, product-comparison, market-analysis, value-proposition, general-report, buyers-guide) rewritten onto one shared section skeleton (title stating the finding; Executive summary; a purpose-specific action/findings section named per template - e.g. 'What to check in person' for buyers-guide, 'Findings' for scientific-paper, 'Recommendation' for the proposals, 'Comparison at a glance' for product-comparison; a findings-by-area table with a citation per row, its area column named per template; 'What the evidence does not settle'; the shared LIMITATIONS_SECTION; Sources appended by the renderer) while keeping each template's audience, hints and tone; the classifier unchanged except that it must always land on one of these; the buyers-guide kept as the approved exemplar.
